result.question: Qual o total e o percentual de internações por doenças respiratórias (CID J%) em cada trimestre do ano no estado do RS?
result.gold_sql: SELECT t.trimestre, COUNT(*) AS total_respiratorio, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_anual FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d JOIN tempo t ON i."DT_INTER" = t.data WHERE i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J%' AND mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY t.trimestre ORDER BY t.trimestre;
result.generated_sql: WITH total_internacoes AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' ), respiratorias AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM "DT_INTER") AS trimestre, COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J%' GROUP BY trimestre ) SELECT r.trimestre, r.total, ROUND((r.total::numeric / t.total) * 100, 2) AS proporcao FROM respiratorias r, total_internacoes t ORDER BY r.trimestre;
